subject: Timebox proposal and escalation: MAP re-plan for Nimbus AI
messages:
From: Sarah Long <sarah.long@nimbus.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbus.ai, tom.patel@nimbus.ai
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Concern: MAP milestone slipping — need a timebox

Markus,

Quick note from our side — the evaluation MAP you shared is drifting on the data-availability milestones. Our infra team flagged that without a hard timebox for the Redwood-side deliverables (model bundle + perf report), we risk missing our internal board demo on 2026-06-18. Can you propose a tightened timeline or a mitigation plan? Procurement is already pushing us to lock licensing and I'm concerned about alignment between your rollout dates and our board gate.

We'd like a concrete 2-week timeboxed plan for the critical path items and a single executive escalation point if commitments slip again.

Thanks,
Sarah Long
VP Product, Nimbus AI
---
Attachment: MAP_v3_timeboxed.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@nimbus.ai>, Tom Patel <tom.patel@nimbus.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Concern: MAP milestone slipping — need a timebox

Sarah — thanks for the callout and the attachment. We agree this needs a firmer cadence. Proposal below:

- Timebox: Redwood commits to a 14-calendar-day timebox for the model bundle handoff and perf baseline (target window 2026-05-20 -> 2026-06-03).
- Acceptance gating: perf report + smoke test pass (pass/fail checklist attached). If we miss the timebox we will trigger an exec escalation and enable a fall-forward: limited-hosted eval (no production data) to keep your board demo timeline.
- Owners: Laura to own delivery coordination, Connor to own perf report and test infra.

I'll share a redlined SOW for procurement to reflect the timebox and the fallback option. Does that meet you half way?

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: eval_acceptance_checklist.docx (document, 24KB)

From: Tom Patel <tom.patel@nimbus.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Long <sarah.long@nimbus.ai>, procurement@nimbus.ai
Date: 2026-05-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Concern: MAP milestone slipping — need a timebox

Markus — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two practical asks from infra/procurement: 1) we need daily status updates during the two-week timebox (email digest is fine), and 2) procurement needs the redlined SOW to review legal/license changes before 2026-05-25. If the SOW isn't in their hands by then, our procurement window compresses the deal close by one week.

Can Laura own the SOW deadline?

Tom
Director, Cloud Ops — Nimbus AI

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Tom Patel <tom.patel@nimbus.ai>, Sarah Long <sarah.long@nimbus.ai>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-20T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Concern: MAP milestone slipping — need a timebox

Tom / Sarah — noted. I'll take SOW redline ownership and aim to get a procurement-ready PDF to you by 2026-05-24 EOD. Operational plan:

- 2026-05-20: kickoff sync between Redwood infra (Connor) and Nimbus infra; I will run and capture blockers.
- 2026-05-21 -> 2026-06-03: daily status digest (08:00 PT) and triage slack channel.
- If we detect an unblockable dependency after day 7 (2026-05-27) we will escalate to the execs and enable the limited-hosted eval as Mark suggested.

I'll attach the redline in this thread when ready.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: procurement@nimbus.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com, Sarah Long <sarah.long@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2026-05-25T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: redlined SOW and timeline

Laura — received your redline. Quick comments from legal/procurement: 1) we need a clarified liability clause for the hosted-eval fallback (who owns customer data during the limited-hosted eval), 2) a firm SLA window for turnaround on data security questionnaires (SOC2 artifacts) — 3 business days max, and 3) a single contract signature by 2026-06-02 to avoid internal budget hold. See inline PDF notes.

If Redwood cannot accept the liability carve for the fallback, we will require additional indemnity language or a one-time credit in the commercial terms. We prefer the credit approach if possible.

Procurement Team
Nimbus AI
---
Attachment: procurement_comments_inline.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Sarah Long <sarah.long@nimbus.ai>, Tom Patel <tom.patel@nimbus.ai>, procurement@nimbus.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-30T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final: timeboxed MAP, escalation path, and re-plan

Team — closing the loop after internal exec sync. Outcomes and commitments we are putting in writing:

1) MAP timebox: Redwood commits to the 14-day timebox (2026-05-20 -> 2026-06-03) for the model bundle handoff and perf baseline. Connor will post the daily status digest each morning to the shared channel.

2) Procurement/Commercial: Redwood accepts a one-time credit (5% of first-year committed spend) as a commercial concession if we need to run the limited-hosted fallback due to Redwood-side delay. The redlined SOW has been updated to show this credit; Laura attached the updated PDF to this thread.

3) Security: SOC2 evidence and security questionnaire turnaround committed within 3 business days for standard items; for deeper artifact requests we'll triage within 24 hours and provide an ETA. Grace will own security touchpoints.

4) Exec escalation: If a blocker remains unremediated after day 7 of the timebox (2026-05-27), Markus (me) will coordinate an exec huddle with Sarah and Nimbus execs and involve Redwood CRO.

5) Acceptance criteria: perf baseline + checklist complete and signed by Nimbus infra lead (Tom) by 2026-06-03. If acceptance is partial, we will agree on a scoped remediation sprint and a demo date.

Next steps: Laura will upload final SOW to the DocuSign link and send the HubSpot update. I'll follow up with the exec calendar invite for the 2026-05-28 mid-timebox check.

Thanks everyone — aiming to keep the board demo intact.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
---
